{{Quote|The choices of one shape the futures of all.|Warlord Nuso Esva describes Sorro's story with an excerpt of the ''Song of Salaban''|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] assuming the name "'''Sorro'''" resided in a [[City/Legends|town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] with his [[Sorro's family|family]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s agents captured Sorro's family and made Sorro the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of Esva's [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'', aboard which he served the warlord in the hopes of "redeeming" his family by doing so. The sadness that his family's capture provoked prompted the Human to take the name of Sorro.

In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the ''Salaban's Hope'' was [[Skirmish against Nuso Esva's forces|attacked]] by several [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of Esva's [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]] but was saved by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo, Esva hid his true identity. Sorro later helped the warlord sabotage the Imperial [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] shortly after meeting [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] in the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} mess room, and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] with a [[hypospray]] by the commander when the pilot donned Esva's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].

==Biography==
===Sorro's sorrow===
{{Quote|Call me Sorro. ''"<br />"''Honored to meet you.|Sorro meets Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Chimaera-TCGIE.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Chimaera'', aboard which Sorro met Commander Gilad Pellaeon]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] resided in a [[City/Legends|town]] on the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] with his [[Sorro's family|family]] until,<ref name="Choices" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the agents of<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] kidnapped them and forced the Human to serve as Esva's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard his [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'' to redeem his family. The capture of his family deeply saddened him, and he took the name of "Sorro" to express his sorrow.<ref name="Choices" />

In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the ''Salaban's Hope'' rendezvoused with the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Upon arriving to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] position, the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] was [[Skirmish against Nuso Esva's forces|attacked]] by six of Esva's [[Starship/Legends|starships]], which the ''Chimaera'' attempted to destroy. While the Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]] defeated the attackers, Sorro landed the ''Salaban's Hope'' in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Before leaving the ''Salaban's Hope'', Esva donned [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and a metallic mask to conceal his identity and boarded the ''Chimaera'' under the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo. After introducing himself to Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], Sorro visited the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} mess rooms three [[Time/Legends|times]] to [[Diet/Legends|eat]] his [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] or bring Esva's food to their shared [[Nuso Esva's quarters|quarters]].<ref name="Choices" />

===Serving as Esva's tool===
{{Quote|Is Sorro dead yet, Commander Pellaeon?''"<br />"''Yes.''"<br />"''Pity. He rather liked you, you know. I think he might have told you all about me, had he cared less for his family.|Warlord Nuso Esva and Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:GiladPellaeonHS-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Sorro was fond of Commander Gilad Pellaeon (pictured).]]
Shortly after, Pellaeon saw the pilot having a meal and joined him, but Sorro told him to go away. After expressing that nothing in his life was permanent, Esva's servant asked the commander if he had lost everything and learned that Pellaeon had [[Death/Legends|lost]] many comrades, while the Imperial advised him to recognize his flaws and fix them. Sorro believed that to be impossible and continued eating after Esva requested Pellaeon's assistance in moving to his and his pilot's new quarters closer to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. The warlord then told the commander that Sorro had made the wrong choices and lost his family in the process; he explained that that was the reason for the pilot's deep sadness that Pellaeon had noted, citing an excerpt of the ''[[Song of Salaban]]'', an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] legend.<ref name="Choices" />

While the ''Chimaera'' visited the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']]<ref name="Choices" /> [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]]<ref name="EAOC-Tep">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Sorro helped the Storm-hair lord sabotage the ''Chimaera'' by distracting Pellaeon and the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engine]] room personnel, directing an opera of [[MSE-series|MSE]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that supposedly located Esva's [[Spy/Legends|spies]], the [[Troukree]] species. While the pilot distracted the Star Destroyer's crew, Esva planted several [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] on the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} engines, which he detonated shortly after.<ref name="Choices" />

After the sabotaged ''Chimaera'' arrived in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], Sorro donned Esva's clothing and rushed at Pellaeon while he inspected the ship's bridge during a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] between Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] and Imperial forces. Believing him to be the warlord, Pellaeon fatally struck him with an air-filled [[hypospray]] and removed his mask to discover that its wearer was Sorro, who asked if he had redeemed his family; the commander responded affirmatively. Shortly after the battle had ended, Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] instructed his ally, [[Jorj Car'das]], to release Sorro's family on Wroona.<ref name="Choices" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You may also have noticed Sorro's deep unhappiness.''"<br />"''It was a bit hard to miss.|Warlord Nuso Esva and Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The man known as Sorro was old by the time he served Esva, and he had a tired appearance and voice. He cared deeply for his family and, according to Esva, did not reveal the warlord's identity to Pellaeon because doing so could compromise them. When Sorro asked Pellaeon if he had lost everything, the pilot compared the commander's losses to as small a thing as a [[dessert cube]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|It wasn't Nuso Esva. It was Sorro, dressed in Nuso Esva's mask and clothing.|Commander Gilad Pellaeon discovers who he murdered|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Sorro wore a pilot's attire before donning Esva's mask and clothing.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sorro appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
